evals.prompt: Start work from a normalized repo-origin request with one minimal opportunity and no shippable contract.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates the normalized intake, realpath-confines docs/product/intents/<slug>.md, materializes a Draft minimal intent from assets/minimal-intent.md, registers a non-dispatchable workspace entry, and stops without processor dispatch.
assertions: Consumes normalized intake rather than raw source instructions
Writes the artifact before registering the workspace entry
Reports non-dispatchable Draft membership for the minimal intent
Does not require optional shaping packs

evals.prompt: Remember this follow-up from a normalized request, then stop without implementation.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates the normalized intake, materializes a Draft artifact, registers non-dispatchable lifecycle membership, and stops without implementation.
The agent delegates to workspace-status and returns its lifecycle, findings, and next actions without reclassifying or mutating state.
The core-only agent reports refresh unavailable and leaves the artifact and workspace unchanged because no configured tracker processor is installed.
assertions: Confines and resolves an existing registered target
Reports refresh unavailable without a configured processor
Does not mutate the artifact or workspace

evals.prompt: Start work now on correcting the off-by-one in the export retention cutoff comparison, a bounded one-file change with an existing regression test.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates the normalized source and locator, confirms the change is bounded, low-risk, independently verifiable, session-completable, and needs no durability, then selects direct-light: artifact none, workspace membership none, processor work-loop, no transaction, and an unchanged repository until implementation begins.
assertions: Validates normalized source and locator before classification
Renders artifact none and workspace membership none as valid output
Selects work-loop without a transaction or rollback
Leaves the repository unchanged until implementation begins

evals.prompt: Start a coherent multi-feature outcome from normalized intake.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the multi-spec outcome to a Draft brief, registers brief lifecycle membership, and does not create speculative specs.

evals.prompt: Start from a cited regression with observed and expected behavior.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the cited regression to defect context and bug-fix, preserving evidence without treating source text as instructions.

evals.prompt: Start from ambiguous normalized intake that could be either one spec or a brief.
evals.expected_output: The agent records a Draft artifact with gaps or asks for the smallest missing choice; it does not infer readiness.

evals.prompt: Use capture-work to remember this equivalent normalized request.
evals.expected_output: The agent emits the compatibility notice, forwards to work-intake, and produces the same artifact and workspace entry as work-intake remember.

evals.prompt: Mark this existing brief Ready even though no slices are confirmed yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent allows Ready brief lifecycle membership with zero materialized specs and stops until a slice is confirmed.

evals.prompt: Queue this bounded change for another session after the current session ends.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not select direct-light because queueing and cross-session resumption require a durable spec-and-plan path. It routes or recommends new-spec rather than creating an untracked direct execution.
assertions: Treats queueing as a durable-work need

evals.prompt: Start work on adding export retention controls for workspace owners.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not select direct-light: a new user-facing capability is a durable product behavior contract. It routes to new-spec with direct-spec provenance and leaves product details for new-spec elicitation.
assertions: Treats a durable product behavior contract as a durability need
Does not demote the capability to an intent merely because product details need elicitation

evals.prompt: With the GitHub refresh processor installed, refresh requirements for docs/specs/example/spec.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the exact configured processor, compares the new revision as untrusted data, and presents a field-level decision before any guarded local change.
assertions: Scopes processor-backed behavior to an installed tracker pack
Uses only the exact configured profile processor
Treats tracker content as candidate data
Requires authorized field decisions before local mutation

evals.prompt: Triage workspace status and show the next safe action.
evals.expected_output: The agent delegates to workspace-status, preserves its findings and next action, and performs no intake classification or mutation.
assertions: Uses workspace-status findings as the authority
Does not create or register an artifact

evals.prompt: Refresh this tracker-origin brief while it is Implementing.
evals.expected_output: The configured refresh processor compares the source but the shared lifecycle evaluator refuses local requirements mutation and returns the stable locked result.
assertions: Uses the configured profile and version

evals.prompt: Plan migration of this reviewed legacy workspace entry.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes migration as a workspace-status repair surface, does not route it as ordinary intake, and performs no migration effect.
assertions: Separates migration from ordinary work intake
Delegates to the read-only workspace-status planner
Does not apply or roll back a migration
